title: Deterministic repo-local development verification harness: classify/risk/claim/invariants/packs -> tsc/build -> report
description: Adds npm run verify:change -- --base <sha>: deterministic change classification into PAIR surfaces, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW risk rules, a permanent invariant registry (~11) mapped to existing tests, patch-claim manifest enforcement (required tests must exist and pass), module test-pack selection, tsc/build gates, and a deterministic .pair-verification/report.md|json verdict. No CI, no server, no LLM judgment, no production-authority change.
